fixes.summary: Fix excessive CPU consumption in W3C tracestate parsing by upgrading OpenTelemetry core from 1.62.0 to 1.67.0.
Fix the Guava vulnerability by upgrading 33.6.0-jre to 33.7.2-jre.
Fix the HTTP Core vulnerability by upgrading httpcore5 from 5.4.2 to 5.4.4.
Fix the HTTP/2 vulnerability by upgrading httpcore5-h2 from 5.4 to 5.4.4.
Fix the HTTP Client vulnerability by upgrading httpclient5 from 5.6.1 to 5.6.4.
